native_child_accounting.method: Only complete line-terminated E/DETAIL/X records are accepted. Every observed ID, including partial E records, has child-emitted E or complete DETAIL entry and matching unique zero exit. Launch alone cannot supply entry. Conflicting types, duplicates, unknown exits, missing exits and additional verbose entries fail.
